phase.instructions: Which subgoal phase should the agent pursue now?

criteria.explore: required objects or routes are not yet sufficiently known
criteria.get_key: reach and collect the key required for the gate
criteria.open_gate: reach and unlock or open the gate
criteria.get_package: reach and collect the package to be delivered
criteria.deliver: reach the dock while carrying the package and deliver it
criteria.recover: recover from an invalid action, contradiction, blockage, or lost progress

action.instructions: Which single environment action should execute next?

criteria.forward: move one traversable cell in the facing direction
criteria.pickup: collect an interactable item directly ahead
criteria.drop: drop or deliver the carried package directly ahead
criteria.toggle: toggle or interact with the gate directly ahead
criteria.wait: take no spatial action for one step

control.instructions: How should the controller handle this state?

criteria.act: execute the selected local action without expensive assistance
criteria.local_replan: recompute a bounded local subgoal without a frontier call
criteria.frontier_assist: pay for slow semantic or planning assistance because it is expected to materially improve the episode
criteria.halt: stop because the state is invalid or outside policy authority

progress.instructions: How much useful progress toward the mission does the state represent?
